title: Resolving topological order crossovers on NISQ hardware
summary: Topological phases of matter provide a promising route toward robust quantum information processing, but on present-day noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices the experimentally relevant question is whether signatures of topological crossovers remain resolvable under realistic imperfections. Here, we address this question in the Wen--plaquette model through a two-stage strategy on the IBM Quantum hardware.
